source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed brake tests in a vehicle inspection report

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
View the last inspection report.
3. Navigate to the Vehicle Details tab.
4. Add a note for the failed test.
5. In the inspection report, go to the Vehicle Details tab and click "Add Comment".
6. Find the Date field towards the bottom of the comment box.
7. Enter a comment to document the failed test, selecting a Date.
8. Add the date of the test failure in the comment and save the form.
9. Navigate to the Search tab by clicking on the back button.
10. Search for the vehicle you want to view.
11. Click on the History button to see the inspection history.
12. Click on the Test ID to view the inspection report.
13. Click on the History button again, then select "Vehicle Details" to view the comment.
